lithium6.name: Lithium-6
lithium6.role: Enriched lithium for breeding tritium fuel

security.text: There is effectively no commercial supply. Only Russia and China are known to produce enriched lithium, and it is export-controlled because of its weapons use. In March 2026 US start-up Molten Salt Solutions signed supply agreements with Type One Energy and Gauss Fusion.

people.text: The legacy enrichment process uses mercury. That is the process behind the Oak Ridge contamination below.

US lithium enrichment at Oak Ridge used mercury. About 1.1 million kg was lost on site, around 10% of it into East Fork Poplar Creek. About 15 miles of the creek still exceed mercury water-quality criteria.

lithium6.bottomLine: Fusion's fuel chain has caused harm before: lithium-6 enrichment at Oak Ridge left mercury in a creek that still exceeds water-quality criteria. Today there is no commercial supply outside Russia and China, and new enrichers are only now signing deals with fusion developers.

beryllium.name: Beryllium

security.text: Has a supply agreement with Materion for beryllium fluoride. Sayari does not show it, which is expected for a domestic US sale.

sayari.name: Commonwealth Fusion Systems LLC
sayari.basis: SEC CIK 0001744079. No beryllium suppliers among its recorded imports.

security.text: Supply is concentrated among a few producers. Ulba is owned by the Kazakh state through Kazatomprom and Samruk-Kazyna (Sayari registry data); Sayari flags it for regulatory action and for imports from a US-sanctioned trader. Kazakhstan supplied 31% of US beryllium imports in 2021–24.

people.text: The main people risk is worker health. Chronic beryllium disease is a lung disease caused by breathing beryllium dust or fumes, and OSHA calls it the primary health risk for beryllium workers.

stages.name: Beryllium ore: US (Utah), Brazil, China, Nigeria

security.text: The US mined 230 of the world's roughly 430 t of beryllium in 2025; about 60% of identified resources are at Spor Mountain, Utah.

beryllium.bottomLine: Beryllium supply is concentrated in the US and in a Kazakh state-owned processor that Sayari flags for regulatory action. The main people risk is to workers' lungs, not conflict.
